title: QA Engineer
description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.

Role Purpose:

WPP is undergoing an exciting global transformation, and we are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Automation Quality Analyst specialising in Playwright to join our quality assurance team. As an Automation QA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products by designing and maintaining automated test coverage, executing test plans, identifying defects, and collaborating with development teams to resolve issues. You will help sustain the reliability of our platform under a trunk-based, continuously delivered way of working. Your work will help us deliver exceptional user experiences and maintain high standards of product excellence. We encourage applications from a diverse range of backgrounds and experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Automation Quality Analyst, you will:

- Analyse business requirements and translate them into robust, maintainable test cases and automation coverage.

- Develop, document and execute detailed test plans and test cases.

- Design and automate end-to-end tests using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript.

- Implement and maintain test automation frameworks.

- Execute automated and manual test cases, and perform both formal and exploratory testing.

- Conduct regression testing to verify that resolved issues do not affect existing functionality.

- Identify, document and track defects using bug tracking tools, providing clear and concise descriptions of issues.

- Review test cases and automated tests written by other QA engineers.

- Embed automated tests within the CI/CD pipeline, keeping merge-gate and nightly regression suites reliable.

- Investigate and address test flakiness to maintain confidence in automated results.

- Participate in design and requirement reviews, providing input on testability and quality risks.

- Collaborate with developers to identify the root cause of issues.

- Work with the DevOps and SRE teams to ensure test environments and test data are stable and available.

- Lead testing activities during sprint and release cycles.

- Communicate complex issues clearly to both business and technical teams, and report test results to stakeholders.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes and methodologies.

- Stay up to date with industry trends and best practice in software testing and test automation.

Skill Requirements:

We understand that candidates may not have every single skill listed below. We encourage you to apply if you possess a strong foundation in automation QA and a willingness to learn and grow.

- 3–5 years' proven experience as a QA engineer or in a similar role, including hands-on test automation.

- Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, tools and processes, and of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

- Experience testing complex web applications.

- Hands-on knowledge of Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript.

- Experience implementing and maintaining test automation frameworks.

- Knowledge of CI/CD tooling, such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.

- Knowledge and experience of API testing (Postman or any other similar tool).

- Experience with bug tracking and test management tools (e.g. Jira, TestRail).

- Ability to lead testing activities during sprint and release.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, detail-oriented with a keen eye for identifying issues and inconsistencies.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field is preferred.

Desirable experience

- Experience working in a trunk-based development and continuous delivery environment.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development and testing tooling.

- Familiarity with basic SQL queries for database validation.

- Exposure to performance testing concepts.

- Experience stabilising large end-to-end regression suites and reducing automation debt.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: QA Engineer – Automation & Data Quality
description:
We are seeking a QA Engineer with a strong automation-first mindset and hands-on experience testing web applications, APIs, and data/analytics systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the code, understands distributed systems, and thinks holistically about quality across the application, data, and reporting layers.
You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Analytics, and DevOps teams to ensure that features are delivered with high functional correctness, system reliability, and data integrity.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Quality Ownership & Functional Testing
- Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineering teams to understand requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, and define test strategies early in the development lifecycle.
- Establish and maintain QA standards, processes, and best practices for consistent quality across teams.
- Validate that delivered features meet functional, non-functional, and business requirements with a strong focus on usability and reliability.
- Analyze test results to identify defects, behavioral risks, and edge cases, and recommend preventive solutions.
- Track and report quality metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, release readiness, and data accuracy.
- Proactively identify risks and challenges within a sprint and propose remediation or process improvements.
- Drive assigned initiatives independently, with a strong sense of ownership.

Test Automation & Engineering
- Design, implement, execute, and maintain automated and manual test cases across backend systems.
- Build and maintain a robust automation suite that is used consistently across releases.
- Drive in-sprint automation, ensuring that new features are automated as part of development rather than post-release.
- Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, and environment stability.
- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery

Data & Analytics Quality Assurance (Explicit Focus)
- Basic validation of data flows between source systems and reports or dashboards.
- Verify correctness of key data fields in reports and analytics views.
- Perform simple data checks by comparing source data with reporting outputs (OLTP databases, payment gateways, CRM systems like HubSpot) and downstream analytics platforms.
- Validate reports, dashboards and metrics for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
- Identify and help prevent common analytics issues such as data drift, duplication, late-arriving data and broken joins.
- Collaborate with developers and analysts to clarify data-related test scenarios.
- Hands-on experience in writing SQL queries with joins for data validation and testing

Non-Functional Testing
- Execute and guide performance, reliability, and basic security testing.
- Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios.
- Work with Engineering and DevOps teams to identify and mitigate production risks early.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
- 5-7 years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering
- Strong experience testing modern web applications and APIs
- Experience testing data-intensive or analytics-driven systems is required
- Mobile application testing experience is a plus

Automation & Programming
- Proficiency in at least one programming language: Java, C#, or Python
- Hands-on experience with automation frameworks: Selenium and Appium for Mobile automation
- Strong understanding of automation design patterns and best practices
- Hands-on use of AI-assisted tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) for test design, automation or analysis

Technical Stack Exposure (Preferred)
- RESTful APIs and microservices-based architectures
- Relational databases and SQL (advanced querying for validation)
- Cloud-based environments (AWS preferred)
- AWS Redshift is an added advantage
- CI/CD pipelines and version control systems

What Success Looks Like at Silvermine
- Defects are caught early, not in production
- Automation is reliable, fast, and meaningful
- Data and reports are trusted by business and leadership
- QA is a partner in engineering, not a downstream function
- You influence how quality is built, measured, and sustained

Why Join Silvermine
- Work on real-world, business-critical systems with meaningful impact
- Opportunity to shape QA strategy across application and data platforms
- Collaborative culture that values ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
- Clear growth path toward technical leadership or QA platform ownership

PERKS OF JOINING: 
The Culture: most companies talk about their values, we live them.
- Supportive Culture: We value teamwork, mentorship, and professional development, and we show it by providing top-notch employee experience and training programs, and incentivizing team growth.
- Work-Life Balance: We support a hybrid work model and encourage our employees to create a healthy balance between personal and professional life.
- Rewards and Recognitions: Competitive compensation, annual and spot bonuses, and a focus on recognizing hard work with well-earned rewards are part of our DNA.

The Work: stability of a market leader with the hunger for innovation and growth of a start-up
